# ElementMap

## Summary

A mapping from a string key to an element.

## Description

ElementMap pairs a single string key with the element it refers to.

## Metadata

- name: ElementMap
- subClassOf: Element

## Properties

- key:
  - minCount: 1
  - maxCount: 1
- elementValue:
  - minCount: 1
  - maxCount: 1
